patches.name: Bypass anti-debug
patches.description: Disables debugger detection and process tracer exit checks.

patches.name: Bypass local account login requirement
patches.description: Forces Accounts.isLogin() to return true, enabling account-gated cards and feature tiles without signing in.

patches.name: MicroG / GmsCore support for Google login
patches.description: Redirects Google Play Services authorization calls to MicroG (app.revanced.android.gms) to fix Google login failure.

patches.name: Premium bypass
patches.description: Unlocks Google Maps, Mapbox, Spotify, and Twin Space features.

patches.name: Unlock feature gates
patches.description: Enables Twin Space, Mapbox visibility, Mapbox demo validity, dashboard VIP tile badges, and Member Center card.

patches.name: Unlock Web Browser & Screen Mirroring
patches.description: Enables Web Browser tile, bypasses driving video motion masks, and forces screen mirroring support.
